title: Onam Vibes
tagline: ft. Siddharth Menon & Zeba Tommy - a festival night of music
description: Kerala harvest festival meets a full live band. Siddharth Menon and Zeba Tommy headline a night of Malayalam favourites, folk fusion and festival energy - sadhya flavours, pookalam colours, and a dance floor that does not stop. Kayal Events signature Onam celebration returns, bigger than ever.
ageRestriction: All ages welcome - a family festival night.
entryConditions: Doors open at 5:30pm. Sadhya service for VIP ticket holders from 6:00pm.

faqs.question: Is food included with my ticket?
faqs.answer: VIP tickets include a traditional Onam sadhya. Food stalls are available for all other ticket holders.

faqs.question: Is the event family-friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes - Onam Vibes is an all-ages community celebration with activities for kids before the main show.
